item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find credible 2024 evidence that Biden manipulated courts, election commissions, security forces, the media, or electoral rules to entrench himself.\nI also did not find strong evidence of misuse of public resources for election entrenchment beyond ordinary incumbency advantages, which are not enough on their own for this lens.\nThe absence of direct counterevidence is itself important here: the available record is mostly about Biden accepting withdrawal and transition, not about anti-democratic rule manipulation.","evidence":[{"title":"Address to the Nation on the 2024 Presidential Election","publisher":"The American Presidency Project / White House","date":"2024-11-07","url":"https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/address-the-nation-the-2024-presidential-election","summary":"Biden congratulated Trump, said power changes through peaceful elections, and directed cooperation on an orderly transition. This is the clearest evidence that he did not try to entrench himself against an electoral result.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.1"]},{"title":"Biden drops out of 2024 race after disastrous debate inflamed age concerns, VP Harris gets his nod","publisher":"Associated Press","date":"2024-07-21","url":"https://www.ap.org/news-highlights/elections/2024/biden-drops-out-of-2024-race-after-disastrous-debate-inflamed-age-concerns-vp-harris-gets-his-nod/","summary":"Biden exited the race under pressure and endorsed Harris, rather than using state power to cling to the nomination. That is indirect but relevant evidence against entrenchment behavior.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.1"]},{"title":"Was Biden dropping out of the race a ‘coup’? This does not prove positive democratic conduct by itself, but it undercuts claims that the 2024 switch was an anti-democratic manipulation.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.1"]},{"title":"Biden says he's \"not confident at all\" there will be a peaceful transfer of power if Trump loses election","publisher":"CBS News","date":"2024-08-11","url":"https://www.cbsnews.com/news/biden-on-dropping-out-2024-race-donald-trump-cbs-sunday-morning-exclusive-interview/","summary":"Biden’s concern was that Trump might reject electoral defeat.
